up: Return a list of all compounds reported in document CHEMBL1789904. For each compound, provide the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum clinical phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Sort the results by ChEMBL ID.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1789904' ORDER BY md.chembl_id
